verdict: No concrete launch blocker found within the narrow navigation-plan contract scope.
manual_review_scope: Compared the five modified production files with frozen iteration14 originals and read the new focused tests.

Whole positive command detection uses the original utterance and a uniquely grounded map destination; no forced repair for questions, negation, compound/unfamiliar wording, ambiguity, incomplete or no-call plans.

Covered commands require exactly one start_navigation linked to a newly planned compute_route for the requested target; extra start/cancel/waypoint calls reject. Both documented search place_id/name references and literal place IDs/names are supported.

Current-intent checks after awaited resolution/repair and after the synchronous rejection event prevent obsolete repair/dispatch. Read the focused cancellation-suppression and synchronous event-sink correction tests.
